series.title: From Chase to Amon-Ra—and Back Again
series.subtitle: Stilly's 2025–2026 trade, playoff-week and keeper sequence

milestones.label: 2025 · September 23
milestones.headline: Stilly acquires Chase and Chase Brown
milestones.description: Stilly received Ja'Marr Chase and Chase Brown from Stew, sending Jahmyr Gibbs and RJ Harvey. This is the beginning of the documented Chase asset path, not a claim that all later value came from this first transaction.

milestones.label: 2025 · November 12
milestones.headline: Chase changes hands in a three-manager deal
milestones.description: Stilly transferred Chase to JMid and A.J. Brown to Thommy; Stilly received Amon-Ra St. Brown from JMid and Jared Goff plus Jordan Addison from Thommy. The exchange involved three separate receiving sides.

milestones.label: 2025 · Week 15
milestones.headline: A 0.12-point win with 61.42 acquired starter points
milestones.description: Stilly beat Kuhl 122.12–122.00. St. Brown scored 35.90 and Goff 25.52 in Stilly's actual starting lineup. No no-trade winner can be determined.

milestones.label: 2025 · Week 16
milestones.headline: Another win against JMid
milestones.description: Stilly beat JMid 126.76–100.46. Goff scored 26.46 and St. Brown 7.40 in Stilly's starting lineup, combining for 33.86 points. The matchup and starter contributions are observed, not a counterfactual trade effect.

milestones.label: 2026 · Draft
milestones.headline: Both centerpiece receivers cost first-round picks
milestones.description: Stilly kept Amon-Ra St. Brown using Round 1 pick 8; JMid kept Ja'Marr Chase using Round 1 pick 4. These are documented 2026 selection costs, not free retained value or confirmed 2027 costs.

milestones.label: 2026 · October 7
milestones.headline: Chase returns to Stilly
milestones.description: JMid sent Ja'Marr Chase and Devaughn Vele to Stilly. Stilly sent Davante Adams, George Kittle and Breece Hall to JMid. The 2026 season remained incomplete at this research checkpoint; no final trade result is assigned.

sources: Original Sleeper 2025 Week16 final paired matchup and Stilly starting roster, verified during November 16 research
limitations: These are documented events on an asset chain, not proof that an earlier trade caused later transactions or wins.
The September 2025 initial Chase deal and November three-manager deal involved different additional assets; no full package-level economic attribution is calculated.
Week15/16 are final paired matchups. No bracket-stage designation is inferred from pairings alone.
2026 keeper rounds record incurred draft selection cost and do not establish 2027 eligibility or cost.
The 2026 season is incomplete; no final season grade or Week10 result is asserted.
After September 2025 Stilly did not retain Chase continuously; the sequence explicitly marks the November move to JMid and October 2026 return.
